verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fedora has other official images, such as a Container_Toolbox subvariant, a WSL base image and a community mention of Fedora Minimal. None of them is shown to be a variant with a different desktop environment or different default apps. Variant selection is a fair axis for an OS, but the evidence does not show choosing among desktop-environment variants, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can choose among official variants of the OS with different desktop environments and default apps
